title: Text: DET Ron Colangelo ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Checking again... stand by. And nice work on the Franklin Perez feature. Looked good in print too...
Cool. Tell him I'll do a good job on it. You here yet?
I am boarding now... headed your way
Do you think it's worth it to ask him?
Free Press getting blowback from Tigers PR. "You know what he's going to say," one said. "I think it would be better to wait until he's here," another said.
From my perspective, I'm expecting him to say no but I think it's worth a shot to put ball in his court. Don't see any harm that would come out of it.
From his perspective, I think it would be a real good thing to get the ball rolling in the other direction. But he's Victor.
